## `scripts/fp/chat/chat_facts.gd`

extends `RefCounted`

What is really going on in the city, for chat answers (slice C): what the district's mayor did on their last turn in spoken words, their latest post, the Gazette headline, the council's last ruling, incidents and sites being built, and the district's numbers. Names only, never coordinates. The live player-reply and talk prompts carry it as "city_facts"; the offline voices quote it. No nodes.

### Constants

- `D = preload("res://scripts/sim/sim_defs.gd")`
- `T = preload("res://scripts/fp/chat/chat_text.gd")`
- `LINE_CHARS = 140`
- `MAX_DID = 2`
- `MAX_LIST = 3`
- `ZONE_NOUNS = { "R": ["home", "homes"], "C": ["shop lot", "shop lots"], "I": ["factory lot", "factory...`
- `SIGN_OFF = [ "Power and water come first.", "I'm watching the numbers.", "Come by City Hall and te...`: How each mayor (by D.MAYORS index) signs off an offline reply.
- `NUMBER_ANSWERS = { "power": [ "buildings_without_power", 1.0, "Power is holding across {where}.", "{n} b...`: A mayor's answer about one of the district's numbers, by intent: [numbers key, the value from which it is bad news, the line while it is fine, the line once it is not]. {where} is the district, {n} the value.
- `COMPLAINT_NOUNS = { "power": "the power cuts", "water": "the water", "sewage": "the drains", "trash": "th...`: A resident's complaint key as people say it.

### Functions

- `static func build(sim: CitySim, brain: CityBrain, people: Residents, dir: CityDirectory, d: int) -> Dictionary`: The facts for district d (-1: the city as a whole): district, mayor, mayor_did ("zoned 6 homes near Elm Street and ordered a fire station"), mayor_when ("today", "yesterday", "recently" or ""), mayor_post, gazette, council ("passed the Youth Curfew"), incidents and building (up to 3 each, "building fire at Elm Street"), numbers ({} outside the districts) and complaints (the top 2 complaint keys).
- `static func mayor_named(text: String, district: int) -> int`: Mayor index named in text: the last name, "mayor" and the first name, or the first name alone when no resident shares it (Rosa does); a bare "mayor" or "mayors" means the mayor of district (when there is one). -1 when none.
- `static func did_words(applied: Variant, dir: CityDirectory) -> String`: A mayor's turn in spoken words, lower case, from CityBrain's applied list ([{"action", "ok"}]): the first MAX_DID orders that went through, joined by "and". "" when none did.
- `static func order_words(a: Variant, dir: CityDirectory) -> String`: One mayor order in spoken words ({"type": "build", "building": "fire_station", "x", "y"} -> "ordered a fire station near Elm Street"), or "" for an unknown one.
- `static func council_words(r: Dictionary) -> String`: What a council ruling changed, lower case ("passed the Youth Curfew"), or "".
- `static func mayor_reply(mi: int, intent: String, f: Dictionary, rng: RandomNumberGenerator) -> String`: Mayor mi's offline answer to the visitor: first person, at most 2 sentences and LINE_CHARS. It answers the line's intent (ChatterMinds.intent_of) from facts f (build() for the mayor's district) and says what the mayor did last; with nothing specific to answer it follows the turn with the mayor's latest one-sentence post or their sign-off.
- `static func city_line(f: Dictionary, rng: RandomNumberGenerator, about: String = "") -> String`: A resident's line about one fact in f. about picks it: "incident", "mayor" (their last turn), "building", "gazette", "council" or "complaint", "" when f has none of that; an empty about picks the most pressing fact (in that order, half the time the first). "" when nothing stands out.
- `static func compact(f: Dictionary) -> Dictionary`: f without its empty fields (the "city_facts" block of a prompt).

## `scripts/fp/chat/chat_feature.gd`

extends `FpFeature`

Global chat and face-to-face conversations (slice C). Normalises every city source (residents, mayors, the Gazette, the council, incidents, openings, arrivals, deals, people hit in the street) into the ChatFeed drip queue, runs ChatterMinds rounds about real events once a minute, answers the player's chat lines, and opens the talk dialogue on talk_requested. Owns the chat panel (chat_slot) and the talk card (overlay). Budgets (D12) are enforced here on the feed clock: one round per 60 s unpaused, one player-reply call per coalesced burst (6 per minute), one talk call per line and one inspect_tile per 20 s. While the player is being answered the drip holds everyday lines and the panel shows who is typing; a status card says when live replies fail or come back. While nobody lives in the city yet, the rival mayors argue in the chat once a minute and answer the player (live only); a player line nobody can answer gets a status card saying the mayors are busy.

- `STATUS_BUSY = "The mayors are busy fighting right now. Chat later."`: The answer to a player line nobody can answer: no residents yet, and the mayors offline or their live call failed.

- `EVENT_TITLE = { "fire": "Fire", "blackout": "Blackout", "sewage_burst": "Sewage main burst", "gridloc...`

- `ASK_OPENERS = { "Resident": "I live here at %s.", "Shopkeeper": "I run the counter here at %s.", "For...`: Openers for the offline "Ask someone here" voice, by role.
- `ASK_FINE = { "Resident": "Quiet street, decent neighbours. Can't complain.", "Shopkeeper": "Busine...`

### Properties

- `topics: Array[Dictionary]`: Chatter topics, newest first.

- `func is_typing() -> bool`: True while the talk dialogue's free-text LineEdit has focus (the player is typing a line).

## `scripts/fp/chat/chat_feed.gd`

class_name `ChatFeed` · extends `Node`

The global chat's message store and drip queue (slice C §1). Every source is normalised to the S0 chat message dict and released one message every 1.5-3.0 s by priority, so a burst of 100 plan lines never floods the panel. The feed keeps its own clock: now_ms advances only through pump(), which _process calls, so pause freezes it and tests are deterministic.

### Signals

- `shown(msg: Dictionary)`: A message left the queue and is now in the chat (the panel appends a row).
- `changed(msg: Dictionary)`: A shown message changed in place (the Breaking card replacing its incident card).
- `pumped(now_ms: int)`: pump() advanced the clock; the chat feature runs every timed rule from here.
- `cleared()`: Everything was cleared (load, New City).

### Constants

- `T = preload("res://scripts/fp/chat/chat_text.gd")`
- `PRIORITY = { "player": 7, "post": 6, "headline": 6, "ruling": 6, "alert": 5, "incident": 5, "notic...`: Release priority per message kind (higher first): player > mayor and press > alerts, incidents and chat status cards > react > chatter > say > letters and logs.
- `RING = 120`
- `QUEUE_MAX = 60`
- `DEDUPE_ROWS = 40`
- `DEDUPE_MS = 120000`
- `AUTHOR_MS = 45000`
- `RELEASE_MIN_MS = 1500`
- `RELEASE_MAX_MS = 3000`
- `STALE_MS = 240000`: Queued lines at or below "chatter" priority older than this are dropped unshown (stale gossip).
- `REPLACE_KINDS = ["say", "post", "headline", "ruling", "notice"]`: Kinds where an author's newer line replaces their queued one (a status, not a thread).
- `LIMITED_ROLES = ["resident", "mayor"]`: Roles the per-author rate limit applies to.
- `INTERNAL = ["_prio", "_qid", "_q_ms", "_due", "_reply_qid", "_exempt", "_norm"]`

### Properties

- `now_ms: int`: The feed clock in milliseconds; advanced only by pump().
- `seq: int`: Last assigned message seq (shown messages are numbered 1, 2, 3 ...).
- `messages: Array[Dictionary]`: The last RING shown messages, oldest first.
- `queue: Array[Dictionary]`: Waiting entries (message dicts with internal _ keys).
- `hold_low: bool`: While true the drip holds queued lines below alert priority: the room listens while the player is being answered (the chat feature sets it every pump).

### Functions

- `func setup(p_ctx: FpContext) -> void`: Stores ctx and seeds the release jitter from the city seed.
- `func reseed() -> void`: Re-seeds the release jitter (sim.city_seed) so two runs on one seed release identically.
- `func make(author_id: String, author: String, role: String, district: int, text: String, kind: String, reply_to: int = -1, refs: Dictionary = {}) -> Dictionary`: A new message dict (S0 §9). text goes through the display filter; refs hold String/int only.
- `func enqueue(msg: Dictionary, opts: Dictionary = {}) -> int`: Queues msg for the drip. opts: "skip" (bool: the fast lane for replies to the player, released after "delay_ms"), "exempt" (bool: no per-author limit), "force" (bool: a direct answer, only dropped as a copy of another fast-lane entry), "reply_qid" (int: hold until that queue entry is shown, then reply to its seq). Returns the queue id, or -1 when dropped (empty, a duplicate, or replaced into an existing entry of the same author).
- `func post_now(msg: Dictionary) -> Dictionary`: Shows msg at once (player lines), bypassing the queue. Returns the shown dict (with its seq).
- `func is_duplicate(norm: String) -> bool`: True when norm (a normalise() key) matches a queued entry or one of the last DEDUPE_ROWS shown messages from the last DEDUPE_MS.
- `func pump(dt_seconds: float) -> void`: Advances the clock by dt seconds: releases due fast-lane entries, then drips the queue (one message every RELEASE_MIN_MS..RELEASE_MAX_MS), then emits pumped(now_ms).
- `func find_queued(where: Dictionary) -> Dictionary`: The queued entry (not yet shown) whose fields match every pair in where, or {}.
- `func find_shown(where: Dictionary) -> Dictionary`: The newest shown message whose fields match every pair in where (refs keys as "refs.<k>"), or {}.
- `func update_shown(msg: Dictionary, fields: Dictionary) -> void`: Replaces fields of a shown message in place and emits changed(msg).
- `func update_queued(entry: Dictionary, fields: Dictionary) -> void`: Replaces fields of a queued entry in place (keeps its place in the queue); "kind" also updates its priority.
- `func by_seq(s: int) -> Dictionary`: The shown message with this seq, or {}.
- `func busy() -> bool`: True while entries wait in the queue or the fast lane.
- `func fast_count() -> int`: Entries waiting in the fast lane (replies to the player).
- `func fast_authors() -> Array[Dictionary]`: Who posts next from the fast lane, soonest first: [{"author", "role"}] (the typing line).
- `func clear() -> void`: Drops every message and queued entry (load, New City). now_ms keeps running.
- `func restore(list: Array, p_seq: int) -> void`: Restores shown messages from a save (already cast and filtered); t_ms becomes now ("now").

## `scripts/fp/chat/chat_text.gd`

extends `RefCounted`

Text helpers for the global chat and conversations (slice C): the display filter every line passes before it is shown or put into a prompt, dedupe normalisation, the checks the reply validators use (URLs, model names, sentence count), trimming, relative times and initials.

### Constants

- `D = preload("res://scripts/sim/sim_defs.gd")`
- `MAYOR_WORDS = ["argon", "deepseek", "kimi", "qwen", "grok"]`

### Functions

- `static func display(text: String, directory: CityDirectory) -> String`: The chat display filter (C §1): SimDefs.debrand, case-insensitive brand words, "AI mayors" -> "mayors", vendor and model words removed, every "(x,y)" rewritten to the directory's place label, "N tiles" -> "N blocks", whitespace collapsed. Never returns coordinates or brand words.
- `static func coords(text: String, directory: CityDirectory) -> String`: Rewrites every "(x,y)" pair to directory.place_label(D.idx(x, y)) ("the frontier" when the pair is outside the world, "nearby" without a directory).
- `static func strip_day(text: String) -> String`: Strips a leading "Day N: " (city_log lines and resident memories).
- `static func normalise(text: String) -> String`: Dedupe key: lower case, letters, digits and single spaces only.
- `static func has_url(text: String) -> bool`: True when text carries a URL or a bare domain.
- `static func has_model_name(text: String) -> bool`: True when text names a model, a vendor or a bare brand word (any case), or a model id from the mayors or the support agents. Validators drop such lines instead of rewriting them.
- `static func sentence_count(text: String) -> int`: Sentences in text (runs of . ! ? followed by a space or the end; a trailing fragment counts).
- `static func word_count(text: String) -> int`: Words in text.
- `static func clip(text: String, n: int) -> String`: Trims text to at most n characters, at a word boundary with a closing ellipsis when cut.
- `static func clip_words(text: String, n: int) -> String`: Trims text to at most n words (adds an ellipsis when cut).
- `static func rel_time(age_ms: int) -> String`: "now", "3m", "2h", "4d" for an age in milliseconds.
- `static func initials(name: String) -> String`: Up to two upper-case initials ("Priya Gupta" -> "PG", "GridFall Gazette" -> "GG").
- `static func first_name(name: String) -> String`: First name ("Priya Gupta" -> "Priya").
- `static func typing_line(names: Array[String]) -> String`: The typing line for who posts next ("Maya is typing…", "Maya and Theo are typing…", "Maya, Theo and 2 others are typing…"); "Someone is typing…" while nobody is known yet.
- `static func cap(text: String) -> String`: Capitalises the first letter.
- `static func h(s: String) -> int`: Deterministic non-negative hash of a string (stable across runs).
- `static func mix(s: String) -> int`: h(s) with its bits mixed (a murmur-style finaliser). Godot's String hash is djb2, whose value modulo 3 depends only on the last character, so "hash(id + day) % 3" would make every letter of a day public or none; mix() spreads it.
- `static func district_badge(d: int) -> String`: Two-or-three letter badge for district d ("NW", "NE", "CTR", "SW", "SE"); "" outside them.

## `scripts/fp/chat/street_lines.gd`

extends `RefCounted`

What the chat hears when the visitor hits someone in the street (game bus person_hit; see docs/fp/ARCHITECTURE.md, Body actions): the one who was hit says so (a shove, a punch, being knocked down, a car, being dragged out of their car) and one of the residents who saw it adds a line, and a crew called to the scene (incidents.gd: police after an assault or a carjack, an ambulance for someone a car knocked down) posts a City Alert card. One victim-and-witness pair per GAP_MS on the feed clock, so a flurry of jabs reads as one scene; a harder blow inside the gap still posts, and so does every crew.

### Constants

- `D = preload("res://scripts/sim/sim_defs.gd")`
- `T = preload("res://scripts/fp/chat/chat_text.gd")`
- `GAP_MS = 8000`
- `SEVERITY = {"shove": 0, "punch": 1, "car": 2, "down": 3, "car_down": 3, "carjack": 3}`
- `VICTIM = { "shove": [ "Some visitor just shoved me on {street}. Who does that?", "Got pushed out...`: What the one who was hit says ({street}: where).
- `WITNESS = { "shove": [ "Did a visitor just shove {who} on {street}?", "Some visitor's pushing peo...`: What a resident who saw it says ({who}: the one hit, by first name, or "someone").
- `CREW = { "police": "Police called to {street} after a visitor attacked people", "ambulance": "...`
- `CREW_AFTER = { "carjack": "Police called to {street}: a visitor pulled a driver out and took the car...`: The crew's card after a blow of this cause, instead of CREW's.

### Functions

- `func setup(p_ctx: FpContext, p_feed: ChatFeed) -> void`
- `func on_person_hit(at: Vector3, cause: String, info: Dictionary) -> void`: person_hit (game bus): queues the victim's line and a witness's, and a crew's City Alert card.

## `scripts/fp/chat/talk_dialog.gd`

extends `Control`

Face-to-face conversation with a resident (slice C §4), and the "Ask someone here" answer. A 600x220 card at bottom-centre over a soft bottom gradient (the upper 60 % of the screen stays clear for A's two-shot): avatar, name, job, mood face, where they are, their line, quick replies and a free-text line. Each player line makes one ChatterMinds.talk call (20 per conversation); a reply still out after 8 s of feed time gets the resident's busy line (ChatterMinds.talk_busy), and the late reply replaces it when it comes. C is the only emitter of bus.conversation_changed: (id, true) in the frame &"talk" is pushed, before the card shows, and exactly one (id, false) on every close path. Only the resident's id is stored; every turn looks them up again with residents.find(id).

### Signals

- `ended(resident_id: String)`: The conversation ended (resident id; "" for an "Ask someone here" answer).

### Constants

- `S = preload("res://scripts/fp/ui/chat_panel_style.gd")`
- `W = preload("res://scripts/fp/ui/chat_panel_widgets.gd")`
- `T = preload("res://scripts/fp/chat/chat_text.gd")`
- `D = preload("res://scripts/sim/sim_defs.gd")`
- `WS = preload("res://scripts/fp/world_scale.gd")`
- `CARD_W = 600.0`
- `CARD_H = 220.0`
- `BOTTOM_GAP = 26.0`
- `FADE_SECONDS = 0.22`
- `MAX_LINES = 20`
- `FALLBACK_MS = 8000`
- `GOODBYE_HOLD_MS = 1300`
- `INPUT_MAX = 140`
- `PUBLIC_LINE_CHANCE = 0.2`
- `EMOTE_TEXT = {"wave": "waves", "shrug": "shrugs", "angry": "frowns", "laugh": "laughs"}`
- `STATE_TEXT = {"home": "at home", "work": "at work", "working": "at work", "shopping": "out shopping"...`

### Properties

- `post_line: Callable`: Posts a resident's public line: func(r: Dictionary, text: String) (the chat feature).
- `mode: String`: "" (closed), "talk" (a resident) or "ask" (an "Ask someone here" answer).
- `anchor: Vector3`: The player's feet when the conversation opened (the distance rule).
- `lines: int`: Player lines in this conversation (each made one talk call).
- `waiting: bool`: True while a reply is out (until it comes, or the busy line after FALLBACK_MS).
- `input: LineEdit`: The free-text line (tests focus it).

### Functions

- `func setup(p_ctx: FpContext, p_feed: ChatFeed, p_minds: ChatterMinds) -> void`: Builds the (hidden) card in the overlay slot.
- `func open(id: String) -> bool`: Opens a conversation with resident id: pushes &"talk", emits conversation_changed(id, true) (before the card is visible), records the anchor and shows their opening line. A conversation already open with someone else is closed first. Returns false when the resident is gone.
- `func open_ask(place: String) -> void`: Opens the card for an "Ask someone here" answer that is still coming (typing dots).
- `func set_ask_answer(speaker: String, place: String, says: String) -> void`: Fills an open "Ask someone here" card with the answer (already filtered).
- `func end(notice: String = "") -> void`: Ends the conversation (or closes the ask card): emits exactly one conversation_changed(id, false) for a resident, pops &"talk" and fades out. notice (optional) becomes a toast.
- `func is_typing() -> bool`: True while the free-text line has focus (the player is typing a line).
- `func shown_text() -> String`: The line the card shows now (the resident's reply or the ask answer; "" while typing).
- `func say(text: String) -> void`: The player says text (a quick reply or the free-text line). One talk call per line; ignored while a reply is pending (the free-text line then keeps what was typed).
- `func on_pump(now_ms: int) -> void`: Timed rules, driven by the feed clock: the distance rule (player feet vs anchor), the resident leaving, the busy line after 8 s (the late reply still shows) and the goodbye hold.
